tasks.short: Maintain animal impoundment files and routine activity reports

steps.what: Capture impoundments and source references in the animal case register
Update dispositions from completed animal handover evidence
Write routine activity reports from the completed register entries
Reconcile animal identifiers, custody dates and unresolved report discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure the animal case register in {OTHER} with linked intake and disposition forms, then render the routine report in {DOCS}. The worker captures facts and resolves custody conflicts; the template removes repeated entry and formatting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Intake, disposition and routine reporting may repeat the same animal and custody details.
tasks.enabler_now: Linked forms and a fixed report template need no model interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting dates and uncertain animal identity require source checking.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a disposition entry contradicts the actual handover.
tasks.altitude: More time is available for resolving incomplete custody histories; decision rights stay the same.

reach.task: Reconcile case identifiers and supporting records

evidence.claim: Linked case forms and template reports can reduce repeated transcription; the local time estimates are hypotheses.

assumptions: Boundary is routine impoundment and disposition administration, excluding the separate cruelty investigation narrative and physical custody work; no report is sent by this design.

The worker produces animal ID, case ID, intake date, location, custody status, disposition date, recipient reference and evidence reference in s1 and s2. Their retained 32 hours include capture and checking; missing or disputed fields remain manual and block automatic rendering of those fields.
OTHER is the animal case register. Test native linked forms and export templates first. Report generation removes retyping, not fact discovery or custody decisions.
The author's ordinary same-system save is included at its small real time, fully retained with no approval stage.
unknowns: Whether the register already links both phases and produces the required report
research_questions: How many routine reports still require manual reconciliation after a native export?

already_counted.description: Capture, source checks and report reconciliation

incremental.description: Field mapping and report template maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=74.5 gives gross25.5 and net23.5 after2 upkeep. Low: incompatible disposition labels leave intake19, disposition20, report31 and reconciliation25 hours, net3. High: linked identifiers work but report exceptions retain intake17, disposition18, report23 and reconciliation25 hours, net15.

tasks.short: Investigate cruelty or attacks and write the investigation report

steps.what: Interview witnesses about animal attacks or cruelty
Inspect the scene and collect physical animal welfare evidence
Record witness notes and evidence provenance in the animal case register
Assess contradictions and distinguish observations from allegations
Write the investigation report from indexed facts and the worker's assessment

loop.purpose: Draft a factual chronology without resolving contested testimony
loop.check: Worker checks each assertion, attribution, chronology and expression of uncertainty against evidence
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported passages are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text testimony needs attributed narrative rather than fixed field concatenation

steps.what: Correct the final report against evidence and unresolved witness contradictions

tasks.design: Use the animal case register in {OTHER} to index evidence and notes separately from interviews and scene work. A bounded draft in {DOCS} cites those notes; the worker checks attribution and uncertainty before completing the report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning separate notes into a chronology requires repeated writing.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-linked draft can assist writing without judging whether an offence occurred.
tasks.still_hard: Witness reliability, welfare assessment and evidential contradictions remain human judgements.
tasks.human_edge: Eliciting reliable accounts and noticing animal distress at the scene.
tasks.altitude: The worker spends slightly less time assembling prose while retaining all investigative decisions.

evidence.claim: A bounded source-linked report draft is plausible; its accuracy and time saving in animal investigations are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes the investigation's witness notes, evidence index and substantive report. Routine impoundment files are separately owned by task7968; there is no repeated reporting credit or implied external report submission here.

The worker produces case ID, witness reference, account date, observation versus allegation label, evidence ID, collection time, collector and custody reference in s3. Its13.5 retained hours include initial capture; missing provenance stays manual and is omitted from model assertions.
OTHER is the animal case register. Test native evidence indexing and report templates before adding a bounded drafting step. Recording interviews is not assumed.
The worker's internal save has no self-approval stage; the separate final factual correction is real substantive report work.
unknowns: Whether source material can be processed within approved confidential systems
research_questions: Does a source-linked draft preserve disputed testimony without adding correction work?

already_counted.description: Evidence capture and final factual correction

incremental.description: Source-link audits and drafting instruction maintenance

approvals.approved_version: The exact question and disclosure to this witness, decided by the worker during the interview; changes require a new decision

tasks.short: Notify identified owners of animals at holding facilities

steps.what: Look up animal holding details and candidate owner contacts
Verify the owner match and appropriate holding information to disclose
Prepare the owner notice with animal and facility details
Check and send the final notice to the verified animal owner
Contact owners by telephone for identity confirmation and questions

tasks.design: Use native lookup views in the animal holding register {OTHER} and a factual notice template in {EMAIL}. The worker verifies the owner match, sends the exact checked notice and handles telephone questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The animal, facility and contact details are retyped into individual notices.
tasks.enabler_now: A parameterised notice and joined record view can remove copying.
tasks.still_hard: Outdated contacts and uncertain ownership prevent automatic notification.
tasks.human_edge: Handling distress and explaining practical retrieval arrangements.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive notice preparation; ownership and disclosure decisions remain with the worker.

evidence.claim: Amivedi operates a lost and found pet register connected with police, vets, animal ambulances and shelters; this does not establish automatic owner matching.
Joined record lookup and fixed notice templates could reduce local transcription; all time estimates are hypotheses.

assumptions: Boundary is owner notification, including its actual written notice and telephone work, not impoundment entry or disposition recording. Shares describe a mixed contact workload, not a mandatory call after every email; no new contact log is invented.

The intake worker produces animal ID, holding location, intake time and contact reference during impoundment task7968, counted there once; here s1 spends20 retained hours retrieving or manually reconciling those inputs and s2 spends20 verifying ownership and permitted disclosure. Notification fields are produced by that verification; no structured match flag is assumed.
OTHER is the animal holding register. Test its native contact view and notice template first. Missing email or disputed identity follows the retained telephone/manual route without an automated send.
unknowns: Actual written versus telephone contact mix and current notice templates
research_questions: How much notice preparation remains after owner verification and a native merge template?

already_counted.description: Ownership verification, final send check and telephone handling

incremental.description: Notice wording and contact mapping upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact recipient, animal identifier, facility, retrieval instructions and final notice text; any edit voids this decision
The exact information disclosed to the identity-checked caller during that conversation; changed recipient or content requires a new decision

tasks.short: Explain animal welfare and control requirements to the public

steps.what: Retrieve current animal welfare and control guidance for the audience
Choose explanations appropriate to the public's situation
Prepare the actual animal welfare handout from reusable guidance sections
Check handout wording and applicability against current guidance
Educate the public through discussion and the checked handout

tasks.design: Organise the current guidance in {DOCS} with dated source links and reusable handout sections. The worker chooses the applicable explanation, checks the final wording and discusses it with the public.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance retrieval and handout assembly repeat material across public sessions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search, maintained sections and document templates can remove formatting and some retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Applying guidance to individual circumstances and checking understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Adapting an explanation when the audience misunderstands animal care.
tasks.altitude: More preparation time can go to difficult questions; no new legal decision rights are gained.

reach.learn: Audience adaptation and source currency checks

evidence.claim: Native document search and reusable guidance sections can support public education; local time benefits are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual handout preparation in a mixed public education workload and discussion. No attendance report or follow-up record is invented. If all material is already supplied ready to use, remove this drafting baseline and remeasure.

In s1 the worker selects source title, issuing authority, version date and applicable section; its17 retained hours include checking those fields. In s2 the worker chooses audience and topic. The template only assembles selected sections; missing or obsolete guidance is handled manually.
Test native DOCS search and reusable sections first. The author's save is fully retained without an approval gate; the public handoff is separately gated on its final version.
unknowns: How often workers actually create handouts rather than use supplied leaflets
research_questions: Does source retrieval or handout assembly account for enough measured time to justify maintained sections?

already_counted.description: Guidance selection and final factual wording check

incremental.description: Remove obsolete sections and refresh guidance references

approvals.approved_version: The exact checked handout version and explanation given to this audience; changed wording or applicability requires a fresh worker decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=91 gross9 net8 after1 upkeep. Low: infrequently reused guidance retains retrieval20 and handout19 with60 other hours unchanged, net0. High: guidance sections are reusable but wording needs tailoring, retaining retrieval18 and handout16 with60 other hours unchanged, net5.
